alex: Quick roundup - ran into different ESM/CJS bundler breakages across Vite/Rollup/Webpack when running the JS SDK in our sample apps (edge & dev-mode focused). Recording repro notes here so we don't forget.

alex: Vite (dev, target: webworker): default optimizeDeps prebundle caused SDK top-level auth to run early -> repeated 401 + retry loop in console. TS overlay sometimes shows SDK types as 'any' because node_modules/.vite contains rewritten files without proper d.ts links.

alex: Rollup (build -> worker, using @rollup/plugin-commonjs): final bundle crashed in edge runtime with `ReferenceError: exports is not defined` due to commonjs wrapper vs pure ESM conflict.

alex: Webpack (dev, experiments.outputModule true): resolver picked CJS fallback in some setups and runtime polyfill replaced globalThis.crypto causing `crypto is undefined` in edge.

priya: Can you paste minimal configs?

alex: Vite: optimizeDeps: { include: ['@redwood-inference/js'] } + worker.format='es'. Repro: import SDK at module top-level and call client.generate().

alex: Rollup config: commonjs({ include: 'node_modules/**' }) -> crash. Workaround: exclude @redwood-inference/js from commonjs transform so it's treated as ESM.

sam: Workarounds I verified: Vite dev - set optimizeDeps.exclude: ['@redwood-inference/js'] OR dynamic import (await import('@redwood-inference/js')). Rollup - add exclude to commonjs plugin. Webpack - force mainFields order to prefer 'module' or add small dev polyfill for crypto.

anya: Long-term for SDK: avoid auth at module evaluation; lazy-init auth client or check for globalThis.fetch/crypto before performing token refresh. Also ensure published tarball includes ESM + CJS builds and dist/index.d.ts so editors can pick up types in dev.

devex-bot: When filing issues include: minimal repro link, bundler versions, node version, OS, and sample-app commit. Tag eng-runtime and eng-ml.

alex: I'll open two GH issues: (1) SDK design change (lazy auth + global guards) + (2) packaging/types (exports map + d.ts shipping). I'll attach minimal Vite and Rollup repro configs and CI failures. Will also add a short note in sample-app README about bundler workarounds.

priya: Please include the rollup config snippet and the exact error from e2e failure. Also ask eng-sre to add a nightly job for Vite dev edge smoke tests so we catch regressions.

alex: Will do and paste links here. Thanks for the quick triage.
